components.name: Solar Cells (monocrystalline silicon)
components.reasoning: These are the primary functional components inside a PV module, absolutely essential for converting sunlight into electricity.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: This protective layer is industry standard in virtually all modules and ensures both weather protection and optimal light transmission to the cells.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: The aluminum frame provides structural support and mounting interfaces, essential for secure installation on residential or commercial sites.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: This component houses electrical connections and bypass diodes, necessary for safe operation and performance optimization of the module.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA)
components.reasoning: EVA protects the solar cells from environmental damage by sealing them between the tempered glass cover and the backsheet, a standard industrial practice though alternative materials like POE are used in some premium modules.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: The backsheet acts as an electrical insulator and moisture barrier, critical for module reliability but occasionally replaced with glass-back designs in high-end systems.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Monocrystalline silicon modules represent approximately 85% of global solar panel production as of 2024 due to their higher efficiency and declining manufacturing costs, making them the dominant commercial standard in the industry.

components.name: Solar Cells (Monocrystalline Silicon)
components.reasoning: Crucial photovoltaic elements that convert sunlight into electricity and are universally present as distinct units.

components.name: Glass Cover Plate
components.reasoning: Transparent protective layer that shields the cells from environmental damage, a standard component in all PV modules.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: Waterproof, heat-resistant backing material that protects cells and maintains performance over time.

components.name: Encapsulant Material (EVA/EPE)
components.reasoning: Flexible polymer used to bond the PV cells together and protect them from moisture and debris.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Housing for electrical connections, protection diodes, and fuses ensuring safe integration into the power grid.

components.name: Frame (Aluminum or Stainless Steel)
components.reasoning: Structural support for the module, allowing easy mounting on racking systems or buildings.

components.name: Bypass Diodes
components.reasoning: Components installed within the junction box to prevent a potentially failing solar cell from affecting the entire string of cells.

components.name: Tabbing Material (Copper Foil)
components.reasoning: Conductive strip used in connecting individual cells together, essential for module functionality but typically integrated into the cells.

components.name: Adhesive Tape
components.reasoning: Used to secure connections between components; while this is a consumable, its presence can vary and often depends on specific designs.

components.name: Grounding Busbar (Strips)
components.reasoning: Conductive strips that make electrical contact with the module frame for grounding purposes, separate from cells or junction box connections.
